The '''Kurost system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the [[Kurosti merchant fleet]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kurost system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
